prompt: Reference images 1-3 show only the drawing style: take from them the line work, colors, shading and simplicity, never their content or characters. Reference image 4 is the main character: keep exactly its head, face, colors, markings, body proportions; change only pose, action and expression. Its ear on the viewer's left is folded down and its ear on the viewer's right stands up, exactly as in the reference image, whichever way it turns; when the character is seen from behind, the folded ear is on the viewer's right. SCENE: tall vertical picture: a small bright kitchen in the morning. The main character stands on a small stool at the counter, pressing the switch of one electric kettle with one paw, a calm determined small smile, and looks at one dirty mug standing a little further along the counter; a hand-drawn dashed curved arrow goes from the kettle to the mug through the air. The flame on the tip of its tail burns steady and bright. LAYOUT: the main character is big and whole in the left and middle; the kettle near its paw; the mug in the right part with clear space; the arrow above them; plain walls; the whole picture is softly coloured with watercolour; no letters or numbers anywhere. If the picture has no specific place, its background is plain near-white paper, even and untinted. Colours: black ink lines on cream paper in exactly the hand-drawn style of the style references, and most of the picture is gently coloured with soft transparent watercolour: the walls, the floor, the furniture and every object each get their own natural muted colour (warm beige walls, honey wooden floor, a soft blue sofa, pale yellow and white notes, cream mugs with brown coffee stains, a sage green kettle), light and airy, with the cream paper still glowing through; never neon, never acid-bright, never flat digital fills, never a single-colour picture. The main character stays black with green eyes, orange cheek marks and an orange tail flame. Every surface is clean and unmarked: blank paper, blank screens, plain envelopes, plain walls, unprinted floor. Keep the main subject well inside the frame, away from the edges. Draw everything in exactly the drawing style of the style references.
